name: Baseus Bass 35 Max Wireless Headphones
description:
Brand: Baseus
Model: Bass 35 Max
Color: Black 
Wearing Type: Over-Ear Headphones
Speaker Size: 40mm
Frequency Response: 20Hz – 20kHz

Connectivity:

Bluetooth Version: V5.3

Supported Profiles: A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, HSP

Transmitting Distance: 10m

Battery & Charging:

Battery Capacity: 600mAh

Play Time: Up to 65 hours

Charging Time: 2 hours

Additional Features:

Built-in Microphone for Hands-Free Calls

Size & Weight:

Product Weight: 0.2345 kg

Package Weight: 0.3000 kg

Product Dimensions: 204 × 191 × 50 mm

Package Dimensions: 250 × 220 × 70 mm

Package Includes:

1 × Headphone

1 × Type-C Cable

1 × Audio Cable

1 × User Manual

1 × Package Box
